newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-FIVE NATIONS TEAMS. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-FIVE NATIONS TEAMS. [CORRECTED 17:00 GMT]

text.p: Teams for Saturday's final Five Nations championship matches in Paris and Cardiff:

France - 15-Jean-Luc Sadourny; 14-Laurent Leflamand, 13-Christophe Lamaison, 12-Stephane Glas, 11-David Venditti; 10-David Aucagne, 9-Guy Accoceberry; 8-Fabien Pelous, 7-Olivier Magne, 6-Abdelatif Benazzi (captain), 5-Hugues Miorin, 4-Olivier Merle, 3-Franck Tournaire, 2-Marc Dal Maso, 1-Didier Casadei.
Replacements: Pierre Bonduy, Ugo Mola, Philippe Carbonneau, Richard Castel, Jean-Louis Jordana, Marc de Rougemont.

Scotland - 15-Rowen Shepherd; 14-Tony Stanger, 13-Alan Tait, 12-Gregor Townsend, 11-Kenny Logan; 10-Craig Chalmers, 9-Bryan Redpath; 8-Peter Walton, 7-Ian Smith, 6-Rob Wainwright (captain), 5-Andy Reed, 4-Doddie Weir, 3-Mattie Stewart, 2-Graham Ellis, 1-Tom Smith.
Replacements: Cameron Glasgow, Duncan Hodge, Gary Armstrong, Damian Cronin, Peter Wright, Steve Brotherstone.

Wales - 15-Neil Jenkins; 14-Simon Hill, 13-Allan Bateman, 12-Nigel Davies, 11-Gareth Thomas; 10-Jonathan Davies, 9-Rob Howley; 8-Scott Quinnell, 7-Kingsley Jones, 6-Steve Williams, 5-Mike Voyle, 4-Gareth Llewellyn, 3-David Young, 2-Jonathan Humphreys (captain), 1-Christian Loader.
Replacements: Wayne Proctor, Paul John, Craig Quinnell, Dale McIntosh, Spencer John, Garin Jenkins.

England - 15-Tim Stimpson; 14-Jon Sleightholme, 13-Will Carling, 12-Phil de Glanville (captain), 11-Tony Underwood; 10-Mike Catt (corrects from Paul Grayson), 9-Austin Healey; 8-Tim Rodber, 7-Lawrence Dallaglio, 6-Richard Hill, 5-Martin Johnson, 4-Simon Shaw, 3-Graham Rowntree, 2-Mark Regan, 1-Jason Leonard.
Replacements: Jeremy Guscott, Rob Andrew, Andy Gomarsall, Ben Clarke, Darren Garforth, Phil Greening.
